The seven-point incidence identity sum_member N_F=21+4b gives b=0 since every listed spectrum sums to 21. Enumeration over finite F2 parameter space is exhaustive; geometric smoothness is certified algebraically by the Macaulay rank criterion rather than finitely many extension fields.
